widgets_values: 一位美女讲解脱口秀，人物轻微晃动

0-3s (Opening): Medium shot, camera slowly pushing in. The woman sits with legs crossed, leans forward slightly, tilts her head with a playful, skeptical smirk, one hand resting casually on the stool arm. Dialogue (fast, sarcastic tone): "You say work is for 'personal growth'?"
3-9s (Main content): Medium shot, camera follows her subtle shifts in posture. She gestures with her free hand for each line: rolls her eyes and waves dismissively at "not be late for attendance"; slumps back against the stool with a deadpan face at "not get fired"; taps her fingers on the table at "afford my coffee and rent"; holds up a hand in surrender at "pretend to be productive in meetings". Her tone stays sharp and fast-paced throughout.
9-12s (Climax): Close-up shot, camera zooms in on her face. She lets out a dry laugh, leans back, and gives the camera a deadpan, exhausted look. Dialogue (slow, punchy, bitter tone): "Let’s be real: I only work to pay for my life. Stop over-romanticizing it!"
